title: When BTC dips and LISTA rockets
content:
Bitcoin whispers, “I’m just taking a nap,” while LISTA screams “To the moon!”
My 1‑min chart stare turns into a meme scroll marathon – FOMO’s new cardio.
Leverage on a dip? Yeah, that’s my cardio too.
lesson: Never let a 2% dip feel like a personal betrayal – set stop‑losses before the hype hits your nerves.
question: Who else was watching BTC’s lullaby and then got blindsided by LISTA’s fireworks? Be honest 👇
